questions.prompt: Which 1955 bus boycott began in Montgomery, Alabama?
questions.fact: It lasted over a year, and the city's buses were desegregated only after a Supreme Court ruling.

questions.prompt: Which particle carries a negative charge and orbits the atomic nucleus?
questions.fact: Its mass is roughly one eighteen-hundredth that of a proton, so almost all of an atom's mass sits in the nucleus.

questions.prompt: In ten-pin bowling, what is the maximum score achievable in a single game?
questions.fact: It requires twelve consecutive strikes, because the final frame allows two bonus deliveries.

questions.prompt: Which 1975 film opens with a shark attack on a night swimmer?
questions.fact: The mechanical shark broke down so often that the creature was largely kept off screen, which made it more frightening.

questions.prompt: Which city is the most populous in South America?
questions.fact: Its metropolitan area holds over twenty million people, more than many countries on the continent.

questions.prompt: Which prize is awarded annually for a novel written in English and published in the UK?
questions.fact: It was opened to any novel published in the UK regardless of author nationality in 2014, a change that remains contested.

questions.prompt: What does a VPN primarily provide to a user?
questions.fact: It hides traffic from the local network, but the provider operating it can still see where the traffic goes.
